description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'DeletedFragment' class, a fragment for handling the UI of deleted notes in an Android application. It manages view binding, menu actions such as emptying the bin, showing hidden notes, selecting all notes, navigating to the search, and showing dialogs.

classes.name: DeletedFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing the UI for displaying and interacting with deleted notes, including menu options, navigation, and dialogs.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for the deleted notes fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as empty bin, show hidden notes, select all, and search.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on data changes, particularly the deletion time indicator.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on a note, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long-click events on a note, triggering menu display.

methods.name: showEmptyBinDialog
methods.description: Builds and displays a dialog to confirm permanent deletion of all notes in the bin.
